items.title: High Gas Prices Are Hurting Impulse Snack Sales. 3 Companies Feeling the Pain.
items.summary: This year’s surge in gasoline prices might be adding a new strain on snack sales.  It’s bad news for  J.M Smucker PepsiCo  and other companies that benefit from so-called “impulse snack sales.”  As a result, many consumers have less money—and less appetite—for the chips, snack cakes, meat sticks, and frozen drinks that are often bought impulsively after filling up the tank.
